name: guard
description: Holds destructive Bash commands until you run, block or allow them, and blocks Claude from reading secret-bearing files (.env, SSH keys, cloud credentials, your own globs).

destructive_bash.title: Hold destructive Bash commands
destructive_bash.description: Hold a destructive Bash command (rm -rf, git reset --hard, force push, ...) until you run it once, block it, or allow its rule for the session.

bash_extra_patterns.title: Extra destructive patterns
bash_extra_patterns.description: More regular expressions (JavaScript syntax) that hold a Bash command, one per entry.

bash_hold_seconds.title: Hold timeout
bash_hold_seconds.description: Seconds to wait for your answer before a held command is blocked.

secret_reads.title: Block reads of secret files
secret_reads.description: Block Read, Glob, Grep and, best effort, Bash from reading secret-bearing files. Writes are never blocked.

secrets_protected.title: Extra protected globs
secrets_protected.description: Globs to protect on top of the built-in list, e.g. ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml or **/secrets/**. ~/ is your home; a glob not starting with / or ~/ matches at any depth.

secrets_allowed.title: Allowed globs
secrets_allowed.description: Globs that are never blocked, even when a protected glob matches, e.g. **/fixtures/**/*.pem. Added to the built-in exceptions (.env.example, .env.sample, .env.template, *.pub).

secrets_check_bash.title: Check Bash commands for secret reads
secrets_check_bash.description: Also block Bash commands whose words name a protected path (cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa, source .env). Best effort: a command can always build a path the check cannot see.

secrets_mode.title: On a secret read
secrets_mode.description: What happens when Read, Glob, Grep or a Bash command reads a protected path: deny refuses it, ask puts it to your permission prompt, off allows it. Writes are never blocked.
